# routeur_workspace_models (Data Source)

Lists a workspace's model catalogue: the models of every provider the organisation has an enabled credential for (curated models plus models seen by discovery), with whether the workspace routes to each. Ordered by `model`. Use `routeur_workspace_model` to activate one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "routeur_workspace" "default" {
  slug = "default"
}

# Every OpenAI model the default workspace can route to.
data "routeur_workspace_models" "openai" {
  workspace_id  = data.routeur_workspace.default.id
  provider_name = "openai"
}

# The models the workspace routes to today.
data "routeur_workspace_models" "active" {
  workspace_id = data.routeur_workspace.default.id
  active       = true
}

output "active_models" {
  value = data.routeur_workspace_models.active.models[*].model
}

output "openai_catalogue" {
  value = {
    for m in data.routeur_workspace_models.openai.models :
    m.model => { name = m.display_name, input_per_1k = m.input_per_1k }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workspace_id` (String) Id of the workspace (`ws_…`), e.g. `routeur_workspace.example.id`.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Only models whose `active` equals this. Omit for all.
- `provider_name` (String) Only this provider's models, e.g. `openai`. Omit for all.

### Read-Only

- `models` (Attributes List) The matching models. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--models))

<a id="nestedatt--models"></a>
### Nested Schema for `models`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the workspace routes to the model. Opt-in: false until set.
- `availability` (String) Last provider discovery result: `available`, `unavailable` or `deprecated`; null if never observed. New values may be added.
- `capabilities` (Set of String) Capabilities from the curated catalogue, e.g. `text`, `tools` (a set: order carries no meaning); empty when uncatalogued.
- `catalogued` (Boolean) False for a model discovered at the provider but not yet in routeur.ai's curated catalogue (prices and context may then be null).
- `context_tokens` (Number) Context window in tokens; null when unknown.
- `display_name` (String) Curated name; the model id when uncatalogued.
- `input_per_1k` (Number) Input price per 1,000 tokens, in USD; null when unknown.
- `model` (String) The model, as `<provider>:<model_id>` — the `model` argument of `routeur_workspace_model`.
- `model_id` (String) The upstream model id. May contain `/` or `:`.
- `output_per_1k` (Number) Output price per 1,000 tokens, in USD; null when unknown.
- `provider_name` (String) Provider slug, e.g. `openai`. (The API calls this field `provider`, a name Terraform reserves.)
